newsitem.title: USA: Quigley gets $2.5 mln in purchase orders.
newsitem.headline: Quigley gets $2.5 mln in purchase orders.

text.p: Quigley Corp said Friday that Walgreen Co and Revco D.S. Inc have placed new purchase orders totaling $2.5 million for its COLD-EEZE lozenge product.

Quigley is the exclusive worldwide manufacturer and distributor of COLD-EEZE, a proprietary zinc gluconate cold-relief formulation which in a clinical study conducted by The Cleveland Clinic has been shown to reduce the severity and duration of the common cold.

In addition, Quigley said McKesson Corp unit Zee Medical Inc has signed an agreement to purchase the COLD-EEZE lozenge to be stocked in about 300,000 First Aid & Safety cabinets located in business and industrial sites, offices and manufacturing facilities throughout the U.S.
The company estimates the first-year value of this contract at $7.5 million.
